finalText:
Build's clean now. Two real bugs were hiding under all that deprecation noise, both from the bundler bump changing shapes on you.

`src/core/options.js` was still reading `options.retries`, but the new bundler hands modules `{ retryCount }` — so it was crashing on `undefined.toFixed()`. Pointed it at `retryCount` instead.

`src/net/retryPolicy.js` had a strict check that only accepted `true` or `false` for the backoff flag. The new config loader leaves unset flags as `undefined`, so it was throwing instead of just defaulting off. Now `undefined` is treated the same as `false`.

Build exits 0, still shows its normal 8 deprecation warnings (those are just noise from Node itself, not bugs).
